source_snapshot.items: Decode Bad Page Threshold Exceed Record
source_snapshot.procedure: Queries device0 UMC then repeatedly injects device3/block0/method5/type4 at raw addresses 0x10000, 0x11000 and 0x12000 before decode.
source_snapshot.criteria: References table6.5 but shows only first-address success and a Fatal/MCE header truncated after sec_count, with no threshold value/field.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; misses raw-address safety, threshold accounting and early stop.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Adds serial/early-stop concepts but leaves target/Script conflict and threshold proof unresolved.

old_problem: Device0 baseline conflicts with device3 target, UMC command with SDMA Script, literal raw page ownership is unknown, and no initial count, threshold arithmetic, complete table6.5 event, early-stop or persistent retirement recovery is defined.
disposition_reason: Threshold, page eligibility and retirement persistence determine the destructive coverage and cannot be guessed from three sample addresses. ED-04/12/14/15/16 prohibit open-ended looping, unknown-address writes and unapproved PASS thresholds. The case remains Pending/BLOCKED.
decision_basis: Read row121/history2512 and kept cumulative bad-page transition distinct from one poison row120 and XGMI BER row122.
Preserved device3 tuple, all three raw addresses/order, device0 baseline, SDMA Script conflict and incomplete table6.5 sample.
Required starting bad-page state, exact threshold arithmetic and one-address-at-a-time observation with immediate stop.
Required disposable page ownership, finite-spare impact and persistent retirement/cleanup recovery.
No address selection, injection loop, page retirement/clear, driver reload, reset/reboot, retry or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: AMD GPU bad-page threshold transition and retirement lifecycle
test_case.purpose: Advance one explicitly mapped GPU's bad-page count using approved disposable pages, stop exactly at the authorized threshold transition, decode the complete threshold event, and manage persistent page retirement without harming unrelated memory.
required_package: Approved amdgpuras build and full AMD table6.5 threshold schema
Reconciled device3 UMC tuple versus SDMA Script and explicit UUID/BDF mapping
Initial bad-page/retired-page count, threshold, counting/persistence rules and severity/action
Vendor-approved raw-address-to-disposable-page map, alignment/page size and data hashes
Per-step oracle, early-stop, spare/poison/retirement cleanup, reboot and restoration procedure
test_case.test_command: Do not run the raw addresses or batch a loop. After owner approval, baseline device3 threshold/retirement/decode state, validate the first disposable page, inject once, inspect counters/decode and decide stop; repeat only for the next preapproved page while below the boundary, and stop immediately on the signed threshold event.
test_case.expected_result: Each authorized page changes only the expected target state, the transition occurs at the approved count and emits a complete fresh table6.5 threshold-exceeded record/severity/action, no extra page is injected, and retirement/poison/data/GPU/host state is recovered or preserved exactly per policy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS without authoritative initial count, threshold and safe pages. Injection success or a Fatal header alone is insufficient; wrong page/device, absent threshold field, extra injection, spare exhaustion, data corruption, reset/hang or incomplete retirement recovery fails/BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Dedicated idle GPU/host with disposable hashed VRAM pages and independent OOB.
Prove each address ownership/alignment immediately before its single injection.
Serialize and inspect after every page; stop on threshold or any unexpected state.
No automatic loop/retry, bad-page history clear or driver reload.
expected_evidence: Per-address transcript, counter/page delta and stop decision
Fresh complete threshold-exceeded table6.5 record with severity/action
Persistent retirement/poison cleanup, data/GPU/host health, restoration and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Preserve threshold and retired-page evidence; apply only the owner-approved page/poison/GPU recovery, respecting persistent retirement and finite spares. Restore tool/driver/debug state, verify data, all GPUs and host, and never add another injection after the transition.

source_conflict.reason: Device0/device3 and UMC/SDMA conflicts remain; threshold, initial state and complete threshold evidence are absent.

blocked.reason: Repeated unknown raw-address injections can corrupt live data, retire unintended pages, exhaust spares or trigger fatal reset before an undefined threshold.
